title: Adaptive Trace Enrichment & Alert Mitigation Gateway
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current alerting surface floods on transient latency/error spikes and produces noisy pages for downstream teams. Traces are sampled inconsistently across services, limiting root-cause correlation and making burn-rate signals brittle.

Goal: Build an "Adaptive Trace Enrichment & Alert Mitigation Gateway" that sits between observability ingestion (traces/metrics/logs) and SLO evaluation. The gateway will: 1) enrich sampled traces with lightweight signals (route, model_id, tenant_tier, request_shard) at ingest time, 2) apply an error/latency clustering step to suppress duplicate symptoms before firing burn-rate alerts, and 3) implement a burn-rate-aware paging mitigation policy that escalates only when correlated signals indicate broad impact.

Scope: This ticket covers the gateway service, the sampling hook changes in host-side agents, pipeline config updates for metrics/log processors, and dashboard additions for the new deduplication and correlation metrics. Does not include long-term storage schema migrations (tracked separately).

Non-goals: Full rewrite of SLO evaluation engine, changes to customer-facing SLAs, or deep-retention trace archival changes.

Why now: Recent outage RCA showed 60% of pages were duplicate symptom pages; lack of trace context delayed mitigation by 14 minutes on average. This work reduces mean time to resolution and reduces on-call fatigue while preserving SLO fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway accepts trace/metric/log events and attaches enrichment keys (route, model_variant, tenant_tier) to >= 95% of sampled traces without increasing ingest latency by > 5ms per event
Burn-rate alert pipeline de-duplicates symptom groups: identical service+route+error_signature grouped within 1 minute and collapsed into a single actionable alert
Paging mitigation policy implemented: automated suppression for low-coverage burns (<5% of tenants) and escalation for high-coverage burns with correlation score > 0.7
Dashboards: new 'Correlation Health' and 'Alert Deduplication' panels added to Console showing dedupe rate, correlation score distribution, and median MTTR per symptom
End-to-end tests: simulated multi-tenant spike reproduces suppression behavior and high-coverage escalation in staging; test run documented and passing in CI
